#2 Gritstone Junction

Through the eastern veins of the city pulses the lifeblood of minerals, travelers, and traded wealth, all converging at the stone-clad arteries of Gritstone Junction. To outsiders unaccustomed to stone-above and shadowed breadth, the maze of subterranean life can seem a labyrinth of madness. Yet in deference to diplomacy and the swell of trade among the Exalted races, Queen Thurgens gave sanction to carve the Eastern Byway, a straight descent from surface to sanctum. Thus was Gritstone Junction born--a threshold between light and stone, where surface folk may tread the undercity's breath.
